summary: Frontend-only ConnectGBB role-matrix and moderation workflow retest completed on local + preview. Pending lock and coach feed access behave correctly, comments query regression is resolved, but moderation report/resolve persistence is functionally broken by RLS/403 failures and preview remains intermittently rate-limited.

integration_issues.issue: Report submission fails with 403 and Postgres 42501 (new row violates row-level security policy for table community_audit_logs); UI shows 'Could not submit report at this time.'
Resolve action appears to remove row in-memory, but request returns 403 and row reappears after page reload; queue status update is not persisted.

integration_issues.flow: Automated role matrix execution on preview endpoint
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent 429/rate-limit behavior causes flaky automation; one full matrix run timed out at login selector while a targeted retry succeeded.
Current /app/tests/test_connectgbb_role_matrix_e2e.py can produce false failures due to session carry-over (logout selector mismatch), causing coach check to run under stale pending session.

action_items: Fix RLS/policy chain for community_post_reports workflow so coach report inserts succeed (current failure references community_audit_logs policy).
In AdminCommunityFeedPage resolve/reject flow, check Supabase update errors before optimistic row removal; only remove row after confirmed success.
Stabilize preview anti-bot/rate-limit handling for role-matrix automation (or provide approved bypass/allowlist).
Harden /app/tests/test_connectgbb_role_matrix_e2e.py by isolating sessions between users (clear storage/cookies or robust logout assertion).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminCommunityFeedPage.resolveReport does not validate update error result before setReports filter, which masks failed persistence and creates false-positive UI success.
useCommunityModeration.reportPost catches and reports error correctly, but underlying DB policy path currently blocks required business flow.
Community feed comments regression appears fixed in this run: no missing community_comments.author_name failure observed; posts/comments rendered for coach.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Local: pending lock and coach create-post access passed; admin queue shows seeded row. Critical blocker is moderation persistence (403 on coach report + admin resolve/reject not persisted). Preview remains flaky due intermittent 429 despite targeted login success.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Reporting/resolution persistence failure. Repro: coach clicks report on /connectgbb/feed then admin clicks resolve on /admin/feed. Console shows 403 and 42501 policy error tied to community_audit_logs; admin row disappears optimistically but returns after reload. Root cause is backend RLS/policy violation with frontend optimistic update masking failure. RCA-2: Role-matrix script flakiness. Repro: run /app/tests/test_connectgbb_role_matrix_e2e.py across multiple roles; logout selector is not consistently found so session may carry over, producing false coach lock failures. RCA-3: Preview instability. Repro: full matrix against preview intermittently gets repeated 429 and selector timeout at login; targeted retry can still succeed, indicating environment throttling/challenge intermittency rather than deterministic selector absence.
